# BMRI.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp5,731.0 against Rp3,610.0 (expected total return 72.4%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: quality_bank_rerating · method card: per fund record routing for Banks.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- CONTAMINATION. S3 (the 2025 Annual Report cited throughout) reproduces broker research: '17 November 2025 3. Verdhana BUY 6,000 ... BRIS ... following the planned transfer of BRIS's golden share from BMRI back to Dananta
- COE is 11.851% (rf 7.45% less default spread 1.62%, plus 0.90 x (4.23% mature ERP + 2.46% CRP)). VAL_BANKS pins COE at the 10y sovereign plus an IDR ERP of 5.0-6.0%, i.e. 12.45-13.45%, and any number outside the band mus
- The terminal ROE of 23.13% (FY2035E) is not sustainable: equity grows from Rp301.4tn to Rp511.3tn over FY2026-35 (6.0% a year) while loans grow from Rp1,740.1tn to Rp3,709.0tn (8.7% a year), so the model CAR falls from 2
